<!--
An assessment report is a CHAPTER of a working-group report, so it has no YAML title: the
chapter heading below is the title, and the group's own template supplies the styles.

Float numbering is external — the working group assigns "Table 6.8", "Figure 6.23" — so
`number-sections: false` and the assigned number is written into the caption text. Label
slugs mirror the assigned number so the two cannot drift.

Sections follow the ICES/AFWG stock-chapter order. Check the current year's guidance before
using this: the sections are stable but the details are revised at each benchmark.
-->

```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "0_setup.R"))
source(here::here("R", "report_helpers.R"))
```

```{r assessment-values}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
# Every headline number the chapter quotes — SSB, F, recruitment, the advice — derived
# once, from the model output. Nothing in the prose is typed by hand: an assessment chapter
# is rewritten each year against a new model run, and a stale number is the classic error.
# For a SPiCT assessment, use spict-wise for the model inputs, fitting, and diagnostics;
# derive this chapter's settings, estimates, diagnostics, and reference points from its
# selected run rather than recreating model code here.
```

## Software and reproducibility

The assessment was run in `r R.version.string` [@rcoreteam]. The report was compiled with Quarto [@quarto] and rendered by knitr [@knitr], and is reproducible from the model output.

This document and the associated analyses were created with researcher-supervised generative AI (<!-- MODEL -->). The authors specified and checked the assessment, and reviewed, edited, and approved all AI-assisted content, for which they take full responsibility.
